title: A separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one is quasi-projective
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphism is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with topological Krull dimension $\dim X\leq1$ [def-pc-dimension]. Then there exist an integer $N\geq0$, a scheme $U$ [def-pc-scheme], a closed immersion $X\hookrightarrow U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and an open immersion $U\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_k$ [def-weil-open-immersion] over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], where $\mathbf P^N_k=\operatorname{Proj}(k[x_0,\ldots,x_N])$ [def-pc-proj]; equivalently, $X$ admits a locally closed immersion into $\mathbf P^N_k$.

proof.text: By the dimension-one ample-sheaf theorem [lem-sc-dim-one-ample-invertible], the separated finite-type scheme X of dimension at most one carries an ample invertible module $\mathcal L$ in the absolute sense of Stacks Definition 01PS.

source.place: Lemma 0A25 (Tag 0A25), proof, first sentence: 'By Proposition 33.38.12 the scheme X has an ample invertible sheaf'; the input is Proposition 33.38.12 (Tag 09NZ)

proof.text: Apply the affine-base ample-to-immersion lemma [lem-weil-pbc-ample-very-ample-immersion-affine-base] with A=k, f the structure morphism X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k), and $\mathcal L$. Its finite-type hypothesis follows from the given finite-type hypothesis, and its affine-base hypothesis holds for $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$. We obtain a projective space $\mathbf P^N_k$ and an immersion i:X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_k over k.

source.place: Lemma 01VS (morphisms-lemma-quasi-projective-finite-type-over-S), implication (1) => (5), specialized to S=Spec(k); the same criterion is the second sentence of Lemma 0A25's proof

proof.text: By the definition of an immersion, factor i as a closed immersion X\hookrightarrow U followed by an open immersion U\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_k. These maps are over k, so the required locally closed immersion and the stated data are obtained.
